The corpus supports both answers.

```json
{"facts": {"diff": "difflib.unified_diff", "flag": "re.IGNORECASE"}}
```

`difflib.unified_diff(a, b, fromfile=..., tofile=...)` compares two sequences of lines and produces a unified diff. In the corpus it appears with `---` and `+++` header lines and `@@` hunk markers, so it suits comparing two config texts line by line.

`re.IGNORECASE` (short form `re.I`) enables case-insensitive matching. The corpus says it makes expressions like `[A-Z]` also match lowercase letters.
